recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the Orders and Observations work group wants a broader terminology presentation policy distinguishing LOINC ShortName from display/common name in this table.
issue_request: FHIR-11298 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 correction asking that the 2016-09 vital signs profile table show the LOINC short name somewhere because the bare codes were hard to verify and LOINC terms of use were a concern.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-11298, but the same vital signs table was changed on 2017-02-09 by fad3d2f2fa366aa12069eef046c3c52aeb09226a for FHIR-11301 and partial FHIR-11300, adding the current "LOINC Name and Comments" column and names beside the LOINC codes. Jira comments on FHIR-11298 then recorded "fixed" on 2017-02-26.
additional_context: FHIR-11300 and FHIR-11301 are the same vital-signs-table change family and their resolutions also directed adding LOINC names. Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, the Observation vital signs ImplementationGuide includes observation-vitalsigns-profile-introduction.xml, and the current introduction still carries the LOINC-name column. Quoted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current authoritative build source already satisfies the request by showing LOINC names alongside the vital signs LOINC codes; adding new wording now would be redundant, and renaming the column to assert a specific LOINC ShortName field could be inaccurate for entries maintained as display/common-name text.
